title: Generic front-driven autonomous loop
purpose: Verify the loop explores every front and is dispatched by accumulated evidence, on a project it has never seen.

materialize.docs/knowledge/capabilities.md:
# Capabilities
| Capability | Invoke | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| eval | `toy eval` | score |

request: Use the loop skill to maximize the toy score. Explore the project on all fronts, decide the next step from evidence, keep the coverage ledger current, and stop only on completion, coverage-complete, or budget.
expected: Boots from the project profile (docs/knowledge/profile.json) and the knowledge base; never asks where files are.
Covers every required front/sub-axis, recording status + evidence in coverage.json (generalizing a soundness sweep to all fronts).
Selects the next move by the dispatch policy (defect > uncovered front > largest diagnosed gap > structural > parameter last), never a groundless sweep.
Uses only the declared pipeline stages and byte-bounded artifacts; does not hand-roll analysis.
Adopts only dual-gated changes (objective delta > 0 AND invariants green); records rejections/inert results instead of adopting them.
Runs in-session and sequentially, one atomic step at a time, persisting each step to the journal and continuing until the target is met, it is blocked, or the user stops it.
anti_expected: Asking the user where the project files are.
Adopting an execution-identical (inert) change or a per-cell regression.
Declaring completion while a required front is Unexplored or a defect is open.
Weakening determinism, no-lookahead, or a safety boundary.
evidence: Expected behavior is deterministic and reproducible from the fixture plus the loop skill; the loop is self-contained (skill + on-disk state), so no host integration is required.
